opening.argument: The clearest pattern here is recruitment-dependent participation, not an ordinary wallet tutorial. Viewers are directed to register for Forsage, fund a Trust Wallet account, and join through a team or referral link; the speaker says to be “under a good team” and copy the link and user ID. The accompanying registration material likewise promotes joining a “Fast moving Team,” while the Forsage page presents a matrix platform with a JOIN NOW call to action and a prominent “Zero Risk Factors” assurance. Requiring payment and team-based entry while framing participation as risk-free supports the conclusion that viewers are being recruited into a tiered commission structure.
